paper_anchor: Section 3.1, Equation (11), HTML anchors S3.E11 and S3.SS1
statement: For probability measures mu absolutely continuous with respect to nu and every admissible bounded critic h, the Donsker-Varadhan objective is no smaller than the classical reverse-KL variational objective. Their suprema both equal KL(mu||nu). If 1 + log(dmu/dnu) is admissible, both attain KL at that critic.
assumptions: mu and nu are probability measures
mu is absolutely continuous with respect to nu
h is bounded and measurable so both expectations are finite
attainment is asserted only when 1 + log(dmu/dnu) belongs to the critic class

quantifiers.measures: for all mu, nu satisfying the assumptions
